notes: Large-source-unit check: the three morphemes of `מִלִּפְנֵי` are genuinely indivisible — the ASV writes one word, *before*, and no English word renders the `מִן`, the `לְ` or `פָּנֶה` in particular — so rule 30 fuses them, headed on the construct noun per rule 23.
*speaking* is `added` rather than folded into the preposition or the noun beside it (rule 20); the ASV italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7).
